short_description: Daylight is an FDA-cleared app delivering CBT for anxiety through guided sessions, available free through many employer and insurance plans.
long_description: Daylight by Big Health is an FDA-cleared digital therapeutic that delivers cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) for generalized anxiety and worry. The app guides users through evidence-based techniques including cognitive restructuring, relaxation training, and worry management—the same approaches used in face-to-face CBT. Programs are personalized based on symptoms and delivered through interactive voice-guided sessions. Clinical trials show 71% of users experience clinically meaningful anxiety reduction. Daylight is available through employer benefits and health insurance partnerships—not individual purchase. If you have persistent worry that interferes with daily life, Daylight offers structured treatment beyond meditation apps.
patient_summary: First FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic for generalized anxiety disorder (GAD). 71% improvement rate with Medicare coverage as of January 2025.

pricing.notes: Requires employer or health plan coverage.

faqs.q: Is Daylight app effective for anxiety?
faqs.a: Yes, randomized controlled trials show 71% of Daylight users achieve clinically meaningful anxiety reduction. The app delivers CBT—the evidence-based treatment recommended by clinical guidelines. It's more structured than relaxation apps, teaching skills to manage anxiety long-term.

Daylight is free if your employer or health plan covers it. Check with HR or your insurance benefits portal. Like Sleepio, Daylight isn't available for individual purchase—access is through employer or insurance partnerships.

faqs.q: How is Daylight different from Calm or Headspace?
faqs.a: Daylight delivers structured CBT treatment—cognitive restructuring, worry management, and behavioral techniques. Calm and Headspace focus on relaxation and mindfulness. If you have clinical anxiety, Daylight's therapeutic approach addresses root causes rather than just symptoms.

For mild-moderate generalized anxiety, Daylight provides CBT comparable to some therapy outcomes. For severe anxiety, complex trauma, or other conditions, Daylight works best alongside professional care. Talk to a provider if symptoms are significantly impacting your life.
